text: だれかが　まよえる　たましいを　しずめて　くれたのね

structure.jp: まよえる　たましいを
しずめて　くれたのね
structure.en: calmed it for us, it seems

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: くれる after a て-form says someone did the thing as a kindness to the speaker's side. しずめて　くれた = 'calmed it for us'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: まよえる　たましい
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. まよえる is an old bookish form meaning 'that is lost'. まよえる　たましい = 'a soul that has lost its way'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end, a soft and feminine form of のだ, shows the speaker working out the reason for what happened. くれたのね = 'so someone did it for us'.
